scope: fafstmobel DFlash2-15 with verify trees and K8V4 on one RTX 5090: the replay fold overlapped with the next round's drafter (e00a1c1), K-split Q4 drafter finish projections (ed1d11d), prompt-lookup match evidence (1e7d9c4) and lookup rounds (7f9ed3a), against 785473a. All changes keep the target's output distribution: the target's weights and kernels are unchanged, the split K is drafter-only, and trees only change which nodes are verified.
hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 32 GB at the 575 W power limit; the desktop (Hyprland and a fullscreen screensaver) shares the GPU and time-slices about 1 ms of every round, so compare within one table

bench.method: ninfer_bench on the bench corpus (corpus_262144.ids), greedy, 256 generated tokens, --verify-tree, optimized proposal head, K8V4, 1024-token prefill chunks, max context 139264; 4 alternating runs per build (profiles/exp/ab_bins.sh); round = decode time per verification round
bench.corpus_note: The corpus repeats a small set of paragraphs, so the greedy continuation copies earlier text and the prompt-lookup chain is right for long stretches. Lookup-round gains on this corpus do not carry over to output that does not copy its context.

engine_only.note: e00a1c1 + ed1d11d against 785473a, identical tokens per round; two independent 4-run A/Bs

lookup_evidence_only.note: 1e7d9c4 without lookup rounds, one run each, tokens per round

serving.method: ninfer-serve, max concurrency 1, max context 32768, no prefix reuse, --verify-tree; server restarted per variant, 2 alternations. Chat: 16 coding tasks with thinking (effort medium), 1024 output tokens (profiles/exp/sample_accept.py). Edits: 4 repository files in the prompt, the complete updated file as the answer, effort low, up to 3000 tokens (profiles/exp/edit_accept.py). Sampling rows use the model defaults (T=1, top-k 20, top-p 0.95).

sampling.note: Sampled trajectories differ between builds, so these are unpaired.

greedy_lookup_only.note: ed1d11d against 7f9ed3a-equivalent build, greedy; isolates the two lookup commits. Half of the chat outputs and all edit outputs diverge at near-ties (see losslessness), so only partly paired.

losslessness.greedy_bench: 3 x 1024 greedy tokens (8K, 32K, 131K) identical between the pre-lookup build and the lookup-round build
losslessness.real_test: ninfer_qwen3_5_dflash2_real_test (chain/tree, B=1/2/8, graph and eager, vision) passes; its new copied-passage case runs lookup rounds and matches the target's prefill argmax token by token
losslessness.selector_test: candidate_selector_lookup_chain equals the tree candidate_selector_tree builds for a certain chain
losslessness.greedy_chat_divergence: On chat task 0, the fold-overlap build reproduces 785473a for 1024 greedy tokens and the lookup build reproduces ed1d11d; ed1d11d differs from 785473a at token 66. Its drafter-only split K changes the lattice, hence the tree layout and the position of ancestor keys inside tensor-core tiles of the tree attention, which flips a near-tied argmax. This is floating-point accumulation order, as in any batch-dependent inference, not a change to the target model.

rejected: GDN g/beta on a side stream with a separate norm kernel: +0.3% (8K) and +0.5% (32K) round time
Small-T Q4 SwiGLU variants (4 row tiles; 4 warps, 3 stages): +0.2% and +0.1% round time

Order-0 FP8 exponent Huffman coding (2.603 bits per exponent, 84-86% of the tensor bytes): decode is issue-bound; best cold GEMV 49.3 vs 52.6 us (-6%), about 2% of a round if every FP8 route were rewritten
A B=1 CUDA Graph family for lookup rounds: about 0.5 GiB more graph allowance for 0.9% of a lookup round (eager rounds idle 541 vs 396 us per round)
W=32 verify trees for chat: about 10.7% more tokens per round offline, but attention, GDN records and small kernels add 8-10% round time at 8K
